Subject: Evidence list + custodian coverage for live witness

Irene,

Thanks again for the quick runthrough earlier. We've started compiling the artifacts we need for our audit team and want to confirm two things before we lock dates:

1) Custodian coverage — we need the list of named custodians who can speak to BCP/DR runbook ownership and the on-call rotations (primary/secondary) for the recovery window.
2) Logistics for a live witness — Estimate of which artifacts you can present during a live witness (RTO/RPO runbooks, restore traces, KV-cache warm traces) and whether these are available by early next week.

Attached is the initial questionnaire from our risk team (see sections 2–4). Can you confirm availability of the items below by COB Wed 7 Oct? If not, propose the earliest date.

Required for the witness:
- RTO/RPO runbook excerpts (service-level anchors)
- Restore timeline traces for last 3 tests
- KV cache warm-start traces (timestamps + node IDs)
- Custodian contact list (name, role, phone/email)

Happy to hop on a short call to align.

Thanks,
Gina

Risk & Vendor Assurance
Shoreline Bank

Gina —

Appreciate the list. We can cover all four artifact categories you enumerated. High level:

- Custodians: Marion Lee (Head of Platform Reliability), Priyom Das (DR Runbooks & Ops), Marcus Lin (Service SLAs) — I will include direct numbers in the manifest.
- Artifacts: RTO/RPO runbook excerpts, latest restore traces (2026-09-18 functional test + 2026-09-29 rehearsal), and KV cache warm traces are available. The KV traces need redaction for internal hostnames — we will provide node IDs and timestamps.
- Schedule: We can produce a consolidated evidence manifest by Wed 7 Oct. Live witness windows we propose: 2026-10-12 (morning PST) or 2026-10-14 (afternoon PST). Please confirm which works with your audit team.

I'm attaching the first-cut manifest and an excerpt from the runbook (for the two services you're focused on). The manifest lists custodians, artifact locations (S3 URIs), and a short description of the data each artifact contains.

Call to action: confirm witness window and whether you require any legal/NDAs signed prior to access.

Best,

Folks —

Quick operational clarifications (quoting Gina below):

> "KV cache warm-start traces (timestamps + node IDs)"

We have two services in scope (ml-infer and embedding-store). For transparency:
- ml-infer: average warm time after recovery (full KV reload) = 18–22s (p95 25s) based on the 2026-09-18 test.
- embedding-store: warm time = 9–12s (p95 15s).

Restore traces included in the manifest are the post-test timelines (request-inject -> completion) with UTC timestamps. Note that some timestamps include internal hostnames; manifest points to redacted traces and a separate hostmap (node-id -> redacted identifier).

I'm attaching the KV warm trace extract you requested (kv_cache_warm_trace.log). For the live witness we can present the full redacted run and walk through the timeline live. Marcus — we'll need a short canary run on 2026-10-12 to validate the witness window; can you confirm ops availability?

- Priyom
Senior Operations Manager, Redwood Inference

3) Access & legal: if your procurement team needs a short access addendum / NDA we can sign via DocuSign. Please forward the link and we'll prioritize.

Marcus — confirmed on the canary? If yes, I'll schedule the ops call and send calendar invites to the Shoreline audit team and procurement.
